description: Check whether a website is visible to AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews). Scores AI-crawler access, JSON-LD structured data, title/meta, Open Graph, sitemap, and llms.txt, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade, and a specific fix for each gap. Free.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

name: check_ai_readiness
